parked.spanish: Entonces cantaba Moisés e hijos de Israel este cántico a Jehová, y dijeron, diciendo: ¡Cantaré a Jehová, porque exaltando exaltó; caballo y su jinete arrojó en el mar!

findings.issue: Qal infinitive absolute + qal perfect of גאה is intransitive/stative (rise, be exalted). «exaltando exaltó» is transitive active and implies an object the tokens do not have, so the subject becomes an agent rather than the one who is exalted.
Yiqtol 3ms does not mark past durative time; «cantaba» selects pretérito imperfecto.
Cohortative 1cs is volitive; «Cantaré» keeps person and number but flattens it to indicative future.

parked.spanish: Y en muchedumbre de tu exaltación derribas a tus levantados; envías tu ardor, los come como rastrojo.

findings.issue: Qal active participle (those who rise) plus 2ms suffix is rendered as passive/resultative 'levantados' (those raised), shifting voice and who acts.

readerNotes.note: Chose 'a enemigo' over 'al enemigo' to avoid supplying a definite article absent from the anarthrous Hebrew participle, without adding an indefinite article instead.
Chose "en" over "de" for the unmarked juxtaposition of the singular participle temible and the plural noun alabanzas, since no genitive relation is marked in the Hebrew.

hold: clause role: the throw verb carries no object suffix or object noun in the Hebrew, so naming the tree as what was thrown (the supplied 'lo' in 'lo arrojó') is a participant decision, not a grammar repair.
